verdict.rationale: Deel documents a REST API with contract creation, OAuth2 for third-party apps to access Deel user accounts, webhooks, a sandbox and an MCP server, and it markets global payroll. None of the evidence describes a white-label or embedded payroll offering, or a partner API that lets a developer run payroll inside their own branded product. Integration access to a Deel account is an adjacent capability and does not count toward embedded white-label payroll.
